# Performance Checklist: In-Browser Indexing

**Purpose**: Validate that SPEC-007 performance requirements are complete, measurable, and consistent for browser-local indexing, local reads, shipped assets, and optional semantic work.
**Created**: 2026-07-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are lazy grammar and WASM-loading requirements defined for all accepted browser-compatible languages without requiring every grammar asset up front? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK002 Are worker off-main-thread requirements defined for scanning, reading, grammar loading, parsing, SQLite storage, publishing, querying, and semantic embedding? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-048]
- [x] CHK003 Are file-read batching, snapshot transfer, worker message payload, and progress-emission ceilings specified so large repositories cannot create unbounded main-thread or structured-clone work? [Resolved, Spec §FR-059, Plan §Verification Plan, Contract §Performance Budgets]
- [x] CHK004 Are SQLite write transaction boundaries and publication requirements specified for index and refresh paths that must preserve the last good generation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK005 Are SQLite query-plan or index-use evidence requirements specified for local keyword search, graph navigation, and bounded impact reads under the self-repo benchmark? [Resolved, Spec §FR-060, Plan §Verification Plan, Contract §Query Rules]
- [x] CHK006 Are memory release requirements specified for parser trees, grammar/WASM resources, SQLite statements/connections, vector buffers, and repeated index or embed runs? [Resolved, Spec §FR-061, Plan §Verification Plan, Contract §Resource Release]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is the self-repository keyword indexing scale target quantified with files, nodes, edges, runtime mode, embeddings state, and elapsed-time threshold? [Clarity, Spec §SC-008, Plan §Performance Goals]
- [x] CHK008 Is the 60-second indexing target explicitly scoped to current desktop Chromium and keyword-only indexing without semantic embedding work? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK009 Is the local-read p95 target quantified at or below 150 ms and scoped to search, graph navigation, and bounded impact reads? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK010 Is the p95 measurement window defined from user action or request start through visible rendered result rather than worker response alone? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK011 Are warmup count, sample count, and deterministic query-suite requirements defined for the p95 local-read measurement? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK012 Are main-thread responsiveness measurements defined with heartbeat maximum-gap evidence and Chromium long-task evidence where supported? [Clarity, Spec §FR-048]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Do Performance requirements preserve the Local-First no-network default while allowing only explicit post-keyword semantic endpoint traffic? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-022, Spec §FR-044]
- [x] CHK014 Do lazy grammar and shipped-asset requirements align without allowing CDN fallback or dev-server-only asset paths? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, Spec §FR-027, Spec §FR-046]
- [x] CHK015 Do responsiveness requirements align with worker-owned SQLite and parser work instead of allowing main-thread indexing as a fallback? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Plan §Complexity Tracking]
- [x] CHK016 Do semantic performance requirements preserve the completed keyword index when embedding is unavailable, slow, cancelled, or resumable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-023, Spec §FR-056]
- [x] CHK017 Do package/static-host requirements align with Constitution Principle VII that new SQL, WASM, or static assets must be copied into shipped build output? [Consistency, Spec §FR-046, Constitution §VII]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Can the 60-second self-repo indexing outcome be objectively verified from recorded hardware, browser, toolchain, commit, graph scale, cache/storage state, timing markers, elapsed time, and run count? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-008]
- [x] CHK019 Can the 150 ms p95 local-read outcome be objectively verified with at least 20 measured samples per operation after one warmup? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-009]
- [x] CHK020 Can no-default-network performance audits distinguish same-origin shipped asset loads from repository-derived or embedding network requests? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-010]
- [x] CHK021 Are package-size and lazy-asset acceptance criteria specified for CLI-served and HTTPS static-host builds, including evidence that grammar/SQLite assets are not eagerly requested before needed? [Resolved, Spec §FR-062, Spec §SC-020, Plan §Verification Plan]
- [x] CHK022 Are actionability criteria specified for progress, cancel, route chrome, and semantic controls while scan, parse, store, and embed phases are running? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-048, Spec §SC-012]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are Performance requirements defined for the primary cold index flow, warm reload/local reads, manual refresh, cancellation, and repeated-run parity? [Coverage, Spec §SC-008, Spec §SC-011, Spec §SC-016]
- [x] CHK024 Are Performance requirements defined for directory-drop snapshots without implying the full Chromium picker/reconnect path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK025 Are unsupported-browser degradation checks separated from full Performance success criteria so Firefox/WebKit do not fail the Chromium-only full path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK026 Are semantic embedding performance requirements isolated from the usable keyword index and specified as cancellable, resumable, and non-blocking for local reads? [Resolved, Spec §FR-063, Spec §SC-021, Plan §Verification Plan, Contract §Semantic Rules]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are quota, asset failure, worker boot failure, worker crash, cancellation, and migration failure behaviors specified so Performance tests do not accept partial or falsely complete indexes? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-038, Spec §FR-046, Spec §FR-055, Spec §FR-058]
- [x] CHK028 Are oversized, binary, unsupported, unreadable, and traversal-rejected files bounded before they can inflate parse, memory, source-cache, graph, semantic, URL, or log work? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-053]
- [x] CHK029 Are second-tab busy states specified before local graph storage opens so Performance tests do not rely on concurrent SAH-pool database access? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK030 Are missing shipped assets specified as fail-closed local-indexing unavailability with no CDN fallback and no degraded main-thread parser path? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-046]
